WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
)
SELECT 'lines' k, count(*) a, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) b, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) c, sum(net_amount) d FROM sl
UNION ALL SELECT 'store999', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, sum(net_amount) FROM sl WHERE store_id=999
UNION ALL SELECT 'ZZ', count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, sum(net_amount) FROM sl WHERE category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'fmt_'||format, count(*), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0, sum(net_amount) FROM sl GROUP BY format
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_orphan', count(*), 0, 0, sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_gt_sold', count(*), 0, 0, sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.quantity_returned>f.quantity OR r.refund_net>f.net_amount
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_before_sale', count(*), 0, 0, sum(r.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date<f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_neg_or_null', count(*), 0, 0, sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line WHERE refund_net<=0 OR refund_net IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_sales', count(*), 0, 0, sum(net_amount) FROM sl WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0

WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id<>999
)
SELECT 'web_status_'||coalesce(o.status,'NOORDER') k, count(*) n, sum(sl.net_amount) net, sum(r.refund_net) refunds, count(r.return_line_id) nret
FROM sl LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=sl.receipt_id LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=sl.sales_line_id
WHERE sl.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'etl_'||CAST(CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE) AS VARCHAR), count(*), sum(net_amount), 0, 0 FROM sl GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fullyloaded_'||CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR), count(*), 0,0,0 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multi_ret_per_line', count(*), 0,0,0 FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns AS net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900
)
SELECT count(*) AS store_days, sum(coalesce(m.net,0)) AS mine, sum(coalesce(c.net,0)) AS ctl,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.net,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches,
  sum(CASE WHEN m.net IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_ctl, sum(CASE WHEN c.net IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS only_mine
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date=m.sale_date AND c.store_id=m.store_id

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net, MAX(l.sale_date) AS last_sale
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'multi_format_stores' k, count(*) v, 0 w FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'max_return_lag_days', max(r.return_date-f.sale_date), min(r.return_date-f.sale_date) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_not_in_fact_but_in_stg', count(*), 0 FROM stg_return_line_load s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.return_line_id=s.return_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'last_return_date', 0, CAST(max(return_date) - DATE '2025-01-01' AS BIGINT) FROM fact_return_line
